bagPolicy.summary: CHI Health Center does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking at the CHI Health Center is straightforward with surface parking available for $10 and garage parking for $15 when available. Bus, RV, and trailer parking is $25, and payment can be made with cash or major credit cards.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in CHI Health Center's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: CHI Health Center offers a diverse range of food and drink options, including classic gameday favorites, BBQ, vegan options, and sweet treats. Highlights include new menu items like Birria Nachos, Chicken Bacon Ranch Sandwich, and a variety of local draft beers and spirits.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Please contact CHI Health Center Omaha at 402.341.1500 and request the Box Office or fill out our Contact Form and select ‘ADA Compliance’ in the subject dropdown. Accessible parking is available in the connecting parking garage and surrounding surface lots at CHI Health Center Omaha.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in CHI Health Center's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at CHI Health Center. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at CHI Health Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
